document.title: Smartphones for children
document.question:
Many children now receive their own smartphone at the age of eight or nine. Some people believe that children should not be given a smartphone until they are at least fourteen years old.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
